card.name: Words before 'the book/story' references
card.fires_on: The word 'the' (or 'of', 'at', 'cited') right before a likely mention of a book, story, novel or film being discussed. It appears in literary summaries and analysis, such as 'in the book' or 'the beginning of the story'.

modes.label: Article before story word
modes.description: 'the' or 'of' after a phrase like 'beginning of' or 'characters in', where 'story' or 'book' comes next.
modes.example: The Smoke Ring was colonized 500 years prior to the beginning of<< the>> story by a crew of 20

modes.label: Reference to a text's contents
modes.description: Words like 'cited' or 'at' that point to a document or novel, such as 'at the end of the novel'.
